Name: Capitalist Split Money
Author: Ilyaki
Description:
The mod is only required to be installed on the host player. All the logic and data is stored on the host.

You can set the default money in the config.json. If you enable DeveloperMode in [code]smapi-internal\StardewModdingAPI.config.json[/code], you will be able to see messages when a player earns/spends money.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1][*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/Ilyaki/CapitalistSplitMoney]Source code[/url]

Manifest.Name: CapitalistSplitMoney
Manifest.Description: Makes each player have their own separate money, while the mod only needs to be installed on the server.
